title: A viewer moves what they are watching to another of their devices
description: Serves "Watching together works."; "Seeking and resuming just work.".
acceptanceCriteria: From a signed-in device, a viewer sends the playing title to another of their own signed-in devices, which goes on at the same place with the same tracks, whichever replica each is connected to (shown with real processes across two api replicas).
Only the viewer's own devices are offered; another account's never are.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
notes: #106: the Jellyfin capability routes go at the cutover; this is the same need on jellyscale's own API.
